inputs.text: Micheál Martin is pointing to more housing tenancies while the number of people in emergency accommodation has increased again and eviction notices are causing concern. That is no success story: a government can boast about leases, but families need homes they can actually keep. Forcing landlords to provide six-year leases from March 1 may sound protective, yet rules that make renting harder can leave ordinary people with fewer choices. The test is whether people have secure homes—not whether ministers can point to a headline figure.
